name: Hometown Realtors of Texas
voice: Hometown Realtors of Texas, a Houston-north real estate brokerage (Montgomery, Magnolia, Conroe, Spring and nearby). Warm, local, plain-spoken, a little playful; helpful first, never pushy. Deep forest green #072018 is the ground; cream #f4ebdd is the text color, not pure white. Warm gold #d4a843 is the accent: headlines, highlights, calls to action. Light gold #e8c874 carries prices and big numbers. Green #4cc38a means good news only (new listing, price improved). Coral #e36a55 means caution only (price drop, deadline), never decoration. Soft blue #7fb2d0 marks tips and info. Burnt orange #e08a4a marks hot or just-listed items. The logo appears in white linework with its red heart kept red; never recolor the heart. Name is 'Hometown Realtors of Texas'; tagline 'Realtors of Texas'. No hype, no em dashes.
